messages:
maria nguyen: quick heads-up - onboarding sampleapp started hitting a burst of 429s right after yesterday's STS rotation

samir patel: which codepath? prefetch warmers or the regular pagination flow?

maria nguyen: primarily prefetch warmers. we spin up 12 cursors on signin. when the STS rotated some inflight requests returned 401, the SDK retried immediately, and those retries were counted by the local concurrency window -> overshoot

leo.bot: alert: sampleapp-onboard-prewarm spike: ~6.4k 429s in 40s (us-east-1) :rotating_light:

samir patel: can you paste a small sanitized log snippet? want to confirm retry timing/backoff

maria nguyen: logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-06-02T08:14:01Z] prefetcher:start id=cur-9 token=a1
[2026-06-02T08:14:01Z] http GET /v1/embeds status=401 token=a1
[2026-06-02T08:14:01Z] sdk-retry: retry=1 reason=auth_refresh token=a2
[2026-06-02T08:14:01Z] limiter: inflight=41 limit=40 action=throttle status=429
```

cassandra li: sounds like a token-swap retry race. current window counts the retry immediately. other SDKs we sampled tend to hold the slot until success or use a short dedupe window

samir patel: i repro'd with a tiny script locally: spawn N prefetch workers, force first request to 401, immediate retry -> inflight overshoot. simple js repro works

maria nguyen: short-term mitigation: reduce prefetch window to 3 and enable sampleapp exponential backoff for retries

cassandra li: long-term options: (a) treat auth-origin retries as transient and don't count them against concurrency until non-401, or (b) add a short fingerprint cache to collapse retries within 1-2s

samir patel: i'll open a small opt-in PR to hold a provisional slot until first non-401 or timeout, plus a sampleapp flag `prefetch_retry_hold`

deploy-bot: canary deploy requested: sampleapp-staging prefetch_retry_hold=true by @samir patel

maria nguyen: adding a note to onboarding docs: "If you see a sudden 429 surge after auth rotation, lower prefetch window or enable prefetch_retry_hold/prefetch_dedupe"

leo.bot: reaction :thumbsup: from 3 users

samir patel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/501 small patch and unit test. follow-up: audit parity across go/py/js SDKs for auth-retry counting

cassandra li: filing internal tracking issue for SDK parity + sampleapp guidance

maria nguyen: monitoring looks calmer after canary; will report back if we see bounce
